nodes.selector: text, g[class*='node'], g[class*='leaf'], circle[class*='node'], circle[class*='leaf'], text[class*='leaf'], text[class*='label']
nodes.note: Accepts grouped nodes, leaf circles, or label-only radial bundles. Count band covers 62 leaves plus optional internal branch groups plus SVG text elements for branch labels. Max raised post-calibration: opus=248, gpt-5.5=269.

links.selector: path.link, path[class*='link'], path[class*='bundle'], path[class*='edge'], path[class*='dependency'], line.link, line[class*='link']
links.note: Dependency imports should render as SVG paths/lines. Min is below the literal import count to allow deduplication; max allows foreground/background path layers. Max raised 260 -> 400 (2026-09-24, d3-power-tools): the data has 118 imports, and a visible layer plus an invisible hit-area layer plus two-column tree edges came to 304 in a working chart.

labels.note: Leaf labels should be visible for most modules; small internal labels are optional.

toggle.note: Required morph control between radial bundled and two-column linked-tree layouts.

encodings.note: At minimum, strokes distinguish dependency paths from labels/branches; optional color may encode team or status.

hover.note: Bare 'text' excluded: the last text in DOM is often a UI label (axis, legend) with no leaf hover handler. g/circle selectors target data node groups whose children hold the handlers. .last avoids depth-1 groups covered by deeper SVG elements.

morph.note: Across the post-click sample window, existing paths or labels should animate attributes/transform values rather than disappearing and rebuilding.

notes: This fingerprint intentionally checks a linked-hierarchy shape without requiring a particular d3 hierarchy implementation.
Hover is class-based because structural.sh can mechanically detect highlight-like class names without inspecting visual style.
The morph trigger is a concrete CSS selector; free-text triggers are avoided because structural.sh dispatches directly through Playwright.
